song.title: You Deserve It All
song.lyrics:
[V1] .G D Found in Your name, the power to save . Bm A G With only a whisper mountains shake . D A Jesus our hope and strength .G D You made a way, unlock these chains . Bm A G Here in Your presence strongholds break . D A Freed by the love You gave
[C1] . D A We give You the highest praise . Em G You deserve it all, You deserve it all
[V2] .G D There on a tree, merciful king . Bm A G Broken and shamed for all to see . D A The Father laid down His Son .G D From darkness to light, death lost a life . Bm A G Heaven and earth will join and sing . D A Jesus has overcome
[B1] . Bm A With every breath that's in my lungs . D A G My heart cries out to You belongs the glory . Bm A Through every loss or victory . D A G My soul will rise to only bring You glory
